actions.name: solve_pickup
actions.description: Grasp a selected compact object, close the gripper, and lift the object from its supporting surface.

actions.name: solve_put_into_bin
actions.description: Move the currently held object above a bin opening, release it into the bin.

actions.name: solve_button
actions.description: Move to a specified button, close the gripper and press it, then withdraw.

actions.name: grasp_and_lift_peg_side
actions.description: Approach a long peg from the side, grasp it securely, and lift it from the table.

actions.name: solve_push_to_target_with_peg
actions.description: While holding a peg, use the peg to push or hook a cube until the cube reaches its target.

actions.name: solve_push_to_target
actions.description: Use direct contact from an empty closed gripper to push a cube across the table to its target.

actions.name: solve_putonto_target
actions.description: Move the currently held object above a specified target, place it onto the target, and release it.

actions.name: solve_putdown
actions.description: Lower the currently held object onto an available table surface, release it, and move the gripper away.
